sn7.9:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagava Kosalesu viharati Sundarikāya nadiyā tīre || || 2.
sn7.9:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena sundarika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Sundarikāya nadiyā tīre aggiṃ juhati aggihuttaṃ paricarati || || 3.
sn7.9:1.3: Atha kho sundarika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo aggiṃ juhitvā aggihuttaṃ paricaritvā uṭṭhāyāsanā samantā catuddisā anuvilokesi || ||
sn7.9:1.4: Ko nu kho imaṃ havyasesam bhuñjeyyāsīti || || 4.
sn7.9:1.5: Addasā kho sundarika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle sīsam pārutaṃ nisinnaṃ ||
sn7.9:1.6: disvāna vāmena hatthena havyasesaṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇahatthena kamaṇḍaluṃ gahetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || || 5.
sn7.9:1.7: Atha kho Bhagavā sundrika-bhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa padasaddena sīsaṃ vivari || 6.
sn7.9:1.8: Atha kho sundarika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo || muṇḍo ayaṃ bhavaṃ muṇḍako ayam bhavan ti || tato ca puna nivattitu-kāmo ahosi || || 7.
sn7.9:1.9: Atha kho sundarika-bhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa etad ahosi || ||
sn7.9:1.10: Muṇḍā pi hi idh-ekacce brāhmaṇā bhavanti ||
sn7.9:1.11: yaṃ nunāhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā jātim puccheyyan ti || || 8.
sn7.9:2.1: Atha kho sundarika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.9:8.4: khettaṃ hi tam puññapekkhassa hotī ti || || 12.
sn7.9:9.1: Atha kassa cāhaṃ bho Gotama imaṃ havyasesaṃ dammī ti || || 13.
sn7.9:9.2: Na khvāhaṃ brāhmaṇa passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇa-brāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yass-eso havyaseso bhutto sammāpariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya || aññatra brāhmaṇa Tathāgatassa vā Tathāgatasāvakassa vā ||
sn7.9:9.3: tena hi tvaṃ brāhmaṇa taṃ havyasesam appaharite vā chaṭṭehi appāṇake vā udake opilāpehī ti || || 14.
sn7.9:10.1: Atha kho sundarika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo taṃ havyasesaṃ appāṇake udake opilāpesi || || 15.
sn7.9:10.2: Atha kho so havyaseso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati || ||
sn7.9:10.3: Seyyathāpi nāma phālo divasasantatto udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati ||
sn7.9:10.4: evam eva so havyaseso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati sandhūpāyatisampadhūpāyati || 16.
sn7.9:11.1: Atha kho sundarika-bharadvājo brāhmaṇo saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || 17.
sn7.9:11.2: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho sundarika-bhāradvājam brāhmaṇaṃ Bhagavā gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn7.9:12.3: na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadanti ||
sn7.9:16.4: tam ahaṃ naraṃ dhammasārī ti brūmī ti || || 18.
sn7.9:17.1: Evaṃ vutte sundarika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.9:17.2: Abhikkantam bho Gotama abhikkantam bho gotama || pa || 19.
sn7.9:17.3: Aññataro ca panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosī ti || || 1.
